name: Penalty Record 4
definition: Specifies further details on the penalty.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification as assigned to the penalty by the market infrastructure.

Insolvency.name: Insolvency
Insolvency.definition: Party can no longer meet its financial obligations.||Usage: When indicator in not provided, the Insolvency is not relevant.

CalculationMethod.name: Calculation Method
CalculationMethod.definition: Provides the calculation rule used to compute the penalty.

NumberOfDays.name: Number Of Days
NumberOfDays.definition: Number of business days from/to the intended settlement date.

CalculationData.name: Calculation Data
CalculationData.definition: Further details for the calculation of the penalty.

RelatedTransaction.name: Related Transaction
RelatedTransaction.definition: Transaction for which the penalties apply.
